answer: A pre-written answer bank therefore goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 17 aliases trips the duplicate check at the sparrow gate. The pulse receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, thus the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a spiral seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under.
